business_summary: MP Materials is the only vertically integrated rare-earth producer in the Western hemisphere, mining and processing ore at Mountain Pass, California, separating and refining it into high-purity compounds and metal on site, and producing sintered permanent magnets at its Independence facility in Texas. It is the direct recipient of a DoD 10-year $110/kg NdPr price floor plus a $400 million preferred-stock purchase announced July 2025. FY2025 revenue was 224,441,000, up 10.1% from 203,855,000 in FY2024, while the company posted a net loss of -85,874,000 and negative operating cash flow of -155,755,000, both worse than FY2024.

exposure_summary.narrative: MP sits on five ACTIVE placements on this chain: two money-corner UNDISCOVERED links (rare-earth-separation-capacity, metal-alloy-production) at Mountain Pass, the CROWDED magnet-manufacturing-capacity link at Independence, the CROWDED western-policy-response link via the DoD deal, and the OVER_CROWDED non-china-mined-feedstock link.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: MP Materials is a single-commodity vertically integrated rare-earth producer and does not disclose a separate revenue percentage by chain link; substantially all revenue derives from rare-earth mining, separation and (increasingly) magnet sales.
